verdict.rationale: Motion publishes an API reference described as "a complete guide on all our endpoints", plus cookbooks and guides with "fully fleshed out examples". A probe confirmed the documented REST API is live and enforces its documented X-API-Key auth. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, so only the reference-and-examples half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable example execution, and independent hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.
